title: Exceptions, Privilege and Mode Changes
description: Explain what happens when a program asks for something it cannot do itself: the gate tables, the ways in, and what the privilege boundary really protects.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Read all 8 concepts, reproduce the 88 checks in courses/priv/assets/samples/crosscheck.py, and then break the pseudo-descriptor read on purpose to make group B fail by name

concepts.title: A Table You Can Locate and Not Read
concepts.description: SIDT returns a base of 0xffffffff00000000 and a limit of 65535, and reading one byte of the table it points at kills a forked child with SIGSEGV -- and the field order is base-first, so getting it backwards returns a plausible base and a limit of zero rather than a fault.

concepts.title: Numbers, and the Ones That Are Not Numbers
concepts.description: Thirty-two of them, eight of which the two vendors disagree about, and a class column that decides whether the saved instruction pointer is the one that failed or the one after it.

concepts.title: Four Ways In, and One of Them Is Not a Door
concepts.description: Crossing the privilege boundary costs 25x for clock_gettime, everything else held constant; and SYSENTER is a working fast path on one vendor and an illegal instruction on the other, with both manuals correct.

concepts.title: The Convention, in the Kernel's Own Bytes
concepts.description: Five SYSCALL instructions in the vDSO, three decoded, a number read out of the kernel's own encoding -- and a symbol called __ehdr_start that points at the wrong image entirely.

concepts.title: The Hole Has No Fixed Address
concepts.description: The first rejected address is 2^47 minus the access width minus one, measured three ways, because the CPU checks the whole byte range of an operand and not its first byte.

concepts.title: Three Error Codes and None of Them Visible
concepts.description: A write, an execute and a read of the same protected page are indistinguishable from ring 3, which is exactly the two bits a demand-paging system needs and exactly the two a process cannot see.

concepts.title: The Same Idea Under Three Architectures
concepts.description: Rings, exception levels, and a mandatory mode below user mode: the numbers change and the five-part shape does not, including a RISC-V that makes the delegation a writable field.

concepts.title: The Harness, and the Eight Things It Refuses to Let Go
concepts.description: 88 checks that assert the canonical-access matrix exactly and the timings only as orderings, and eight retractions that are printed by the artifact and asserted as text so that neither can be dropped quietly nor deleted.
